source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第四册 Unit 1 同主题完形(高中后的计划/AI与未来职业/年轻发明家/艰难抉择/面试准备/海外间隔年来信)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一、4选项同词性,与阅读听力关不撞。

passages.title: After Senior High
passages.text: Now that I have been at senior high for over a year, my teacher has asked us to think about the (1)____. I feel quite (2)____ about my progress so far, though there are still goals I have not (3)____ yet. My biggest (4)____ is to study computer science and one day build robots that help people. To reach it, I (5)____ to work much harder at maths and coding. I know that having a plan is no (6)____ that everything will come true, but it still gives me a clear (7)____. When I feel unsure, I try not to (8)____ up good chances too quickly. Instead, I (9)____ up the choices carefully before I (10)____ a decision. Step by step, I am getting ready for the future.

questions.explanation: think about the future,谈论未来。
feel satisfied about my progress,对进步感到满意。
goals I have not achieved,尚未实现的目标。
My biggest ambition is to ...,最大的理想。
plan to work harder,打算更努力;后三个为否定意义,与上下文矛盾。
no guarantee that ...,不能保证。
a clear direction,清晰的方向。
pass up good chances,错过好机会。
weigh up the choices,权衡选择。
make a decision,固定搭配。

passages.title: How AI Will Change Jobs
passages.text: Many people wonder how computers and robots will (1)____ the world of work. Some jobs that exist today may slowly (2)____, while completely new ones will appear. Machines are already good at boring and repeated tasks, so workers will have more time for (3)____ thinking and creative ideas. However, this change also brings a real (4)____: should we welcome the new technology or fear it? Experts say the wisest (5)____ is to keep learning new skills throughout our lives. A person who is willing to (6)____ to new tools will always be useful. We should not (7)____ up the chance to learn just because it feels hard. Instead, we ought to take (8)____ early and prepare for the future. Those who plan ahead are usually more (9)____ than those who simply wait. In the end, technology is a (10)____ of both challenge and opportunity.

questions.explanation: change the world of work,改变职场。
jobs may disappear,工作可能消失。
complex thinking,复杂的思考。
a real dilemma: ... or ...,两难。
the wisest choice is to ...,最明智的选择。
willing to adapt to new tools,适应新工具;后三个为否定态度。
give up the chance,放弃机会。
take action,采取行动。
more successful than ...,更成功。
a mixture of challenge and opportunity,二者的混合。

passages.title: A Young Inventor
passages.text: When Mia was still a girl, she already had a clear (1)____ to become an engineer. At school she joined every science club and never (2)____ up a chance to build something new. Her teachers said she was (3)____ and full of energy. One day she read about a robot that could help blind people cross the road, and the idea (4)____ in her mind for weeks. She decided to take (5)____ and design her own version. The work was not easy, and many problems (6)____ along the way. Sometimes she had (7)____ thoughts and wondered whether she should give up. But she always chose to (8)____ up the good and bad points and keep going. (9)____, after two years of hard work, her robot won a national prize. Mia is now sure that a strong dream, plus daily effort, can shape a bright (10)____.

questions.explanation: a clear ambition to ...,明确的理想。
never passed up a chance,从不错过机会。
ambitious and full of energy,有抱负、充满活力。
the idea stayed in her mind,这个想法停留在脑海里。
take action,采取行动。
many problems arose,出现了许多问题。
have second thoughts,犹豫。
weigh up the good and bad points,权衡利弊。
Ultimately, after two years ...,最终。
shape a bright future,塑造光明的未来。

passages.title: A Difficult Decision
passages.text: Li Ling was facing a hard (1)____ about her future. She had been (2)____ for early admission to study physics at a top university, which sounded wonderful. Yet she had always wanted to become a doctor, so she felt unable to (3)____ up her mind. Her friend Jenny told her not to (4)____ up such a rare opportunity without thinking. At the same time, Jenny said it would be wrong to (5)____ the dream of medicine completely. The two girls decided to (6)____ up the advantages and disadvantages of each path. Li Ling realised that, whatever she chose, the (7)____ would shape her whole life. She did not want to act too fast and later have (8)____ thoughts. In the end she promised to (9)____ off the final choice until she had spoken to her teacher. Sometimes the wisest step is to (10)____ a little more time.

questions.explanation: a hard decision,艰难的决定。
been recommended for admission,被推荐录取。
make up her mind,拿定主意。
pass up the opportunity,错过机会。
reject the dream completely,完全放弃梦想。
weigh up the advantages and disadvantages,权衡利弊。
the choice would shape her life,选择决定人生。
have second thoughts,犹豫、反悔。
put off the final choice,推迟最终选择。
take a little more time,多花点时间。

passages.title: Getting Ready for an Interview
passages.text: Last summer Richard decided to apply for a part-time (1)____ at a local youth hostel. He had always been interested in travel, so the work seemed (2)____ for him. Before the interview, he prepared carefully and tried to think of polite (3)____ to ask the manager. He knew that good people skills would make him a strong (4)____. During the meeting, he spoke with (5)____ and answered every question clearly. When the manager asked why he wanted the job, Richard explained that the (6)____ would help him grow more independent. He also said that earlier holiday jobs had made him a (7)____ and flexible person. The manager was clearly (8)____ and offered him the position. Richard learned that being well prepared can (9)____ all the difference. If you ever (10)____ a job interview, remember to stay calm and be honest.

questions.explanation: a part-time job,兼职工作。
the work seemed perfect for him,非常合适。
polite questions to ask,礼貌的问题。
a strong candidate,有力的应聘者。
spoke with confidence,自信地说;后三个为消极情绪。
the experience would help him grow,这段经历有助成长。
a confident and flexible person,自信而灵活的人。
the manager was impressed,经理印象深刻。
make all the difference,起决定性作用。
face a job interview,面对面试。

passages.title: A Gap Year Abroad
passages.text: Dear Anna, I am writing from a small village where I am spending my gap (1)____ as a volunteer. Every morning the birds wake me at dawn, and already the work (2)____. For the past two months we have been building a new roof for the village school. Despite the hard physical work, I do not (3)____ my choice for a single moment. The local people are friendly and (4)____ to share their lives with us. This experience has been a wonderful (5)____ for my personal growth. I feel happy, free, and a little (6)____ than before, because I exercise every day. Of course, life here is not always easy, and small problems often (7)____. Yet I have learned to (8)____ each difficulty calmly and find a solution. When this year (9)____, I will surely keep learning about how other people live. I am sure this adventure will (10)____ my whole future. Yours, David

questions.explanation: my gap year,间隔年。
already the work begins,工作就开始了。
do not regret my choice,不后悔选择。
willing to share,乐于分享。
a wonderful opportunity,绝佳机会。
a little fitter ... because I exercise,更健康。
small problems arise,小问题出现。
face each difficulty calmly,冷静面对困难。
when this year ends,当这一年结束时。
shape my whole future,塑造我的未来。
